name: Konbini Shoujo
source:
I am the manager of a conveniece store. One day, I catch a shoplifter in the act.

"Shall we take this down to the police station? Or maybe..."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180409161811mp_/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031422.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我是一家便利店的经理。有一天，我抓住了一名正在行窃的小偷。

“我们要把这个带到警察局吗？或者也许……”

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180409161811mp_/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031422.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
